people.role: Lamp-bearer of the night crossings: carries the lead lamp through the Tower's dark forest
people.appearance: Lamp-burn on his chin, earned reading the road by night.
people.backstory: Has carried the lead lamp on the night crossings for forty years and been fined by the Tower's patrols eleven times; he pays each fine in rice and lights the lamp again at the next bend.

ties.note: the Road Mother, who keeps the lamps' roll
meets every night crossing at the ferry

tree.intent: Wood sustain for a man who walks all night.

people.role: Master of the staff grove at Phạt Trúc Thôn; cuts and judges every disciple's first staff
people.appearance: Left thumb pared flat by the bamboo knife.
people.backstory: Refuses a staff to any child who cuts a culm in flower, and has refused one of the head's own grandnephews twice; he thinks Nghiêm Quy Khứ (nghiem_quy_khu) passes children through the outer gate before their staffs are judged. He judges a first staff by the sound the culm makes when he flicks it, and will not say what the sound should be.

ties.note: the outer gate's haste against the grove's judgement

tree.intent: Wood health and the staff's slow weight.

people.role: Carries the second lamp on the night crossings, behind her father
people.appearance: Smudges soot on her chin to match her father's lamp-burn.
people.backstory: Walks behind her father with the second lamp and wants to carry the first; she ran once on the road at fourteen and carried a porter's load for a month for it.

ties.note: the Vũ Linh climber whose bells she walks under

people.role: Mine runner at Tử Tinh Khoáng; carries the warden's tallies up to the pass
people.appearance: Flinches at any loud noise, and has lost three hats to the wind this season.
people.backstory: The Tower's Bell Test found no Thunder in him and took his sister up the ridge without him; he has heard the drumming under Tử Tinh too, and told only Úc Yên Vũ (uc_yen_vu). Nothing has ever gone his way.

people.role: Pole-boy on the Hà Châu ferry
people.appearance: Shows the gold tooth to everyone, though it is brass.
people.backstory: Poles the ferry for his uncle and swears the risen isle off Hà Châu is a fort site, which puts him against Lô Tân Châu (lo_tan_chau) of Cốc Vũ Quán in every tavern on the river. He charges foot-travellers twice and calls it the isle toll; a pedlar's widow sold her mule to cross.

ties.note: the isle: fort or rice mud

people.role: Coast guide at Vọng Hải Trấn; carries the Road Mother's letters to the boats
people.appearance: Her pouch is rubbed pale where she touches it when she is listening.
people.backstory: Carries the Road Mother's letters down to the coast boats, and has noticed that one letter from the Tower came back unanswered and was not burned. She read the Road Mother's offer of the Vọng Hải run aloud at the coast inn to buy a share in a boat, and Phí Thoa Y (phi_thoa_y) lost the run.

ties.note: the Road Mother owes her a season's fees

people.role: A Tower deserter who walked home to the Gate in 1190
people.appearance: The Tower's bell mark scratched out of his shoulder with a hot nail.
people.backstory: Walked home from the Tower in 1190 with his Thunder half-woken, as Nghiêm Quy Khứ (nghiem_quy_khu) did before him; the Gate cannot teach it, and the Tower still writes to his mother. He walked past a Tower mule-boy drowning at the ford; the boy was fished out dead at the weir, and he has not gone to the ford since.

ties.note: the door girl at Hồng Đậu who saves him a bean

tree.intent: The Thunder no one at the Gate can teach.
